migrationImpact.newRepoScopedKey: New key over (repository identity, normalized source_ref, packet kind) at full digest width. The 61,718 existing packet:<12hex> keys stay valid via atlas_packet_identity_aliases (additive alias rows, no PK/FK mutation); new admissions use the new key. Qdrant payloads, Redis/BitFrost keys, atlas_packet_registry_projections FKs, and atlas_packet_chunk_lineage all reference the old key and keep resolving through the resolver. Two live schemes coexist until a migration is separately authorized.
